Name: Restore Hat Mouse's House
Author: bsavage81
Description:
Has the run down house that the Hat Mouse lives in brought down property values in the Valley? Why not help the mouse out and restore it to glory.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/211929328-1763926725.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Restore the exterior by completing a bundle
[*]Restore and furnish the interior by completing a series of bundles
[/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/211929328-1763926791.png[/img]

﻿ [size=3]﻿**Now compatible with the newest version of [/size][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17364]Hat Mouse and Friends[/url]**[/size]

[list]
[*]Compatible with SVE and most other major extensions﻿
[*]NOT COMPATIBLE with Hat Mouse Lacey
[/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/211929328-1763926952.png[/img]﻿﻿[list]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17265]Unlockable Bundles[/url].﻿
[*]Unzip this mod's folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
[*]Run the game.
[/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/211929328-1763927006.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Thanks to PeacefulEnd for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17291]Hat Shop Restored[/url] for the inspiration behind creating this pack.﻿
[*]Thank you to Huskyn1nja and Summer Spongle for testing
[*]Description separators made via https://www.kdau.com/scrollish/
[/list]
